ai.metaDescription: How Northern Studio approaches intelligent systems, AI agents and business software: with a purpose, boundaries and human control.
ai.title: Intelligent systems, with limits.
ai.lede: We design AI as software: a purpose, a context, a way to steer it, and a place in the organisation that has to live with it.
ai.figureIntro: An intelligent system is a stack, not a loose model. Each layer has a job.

layers.title: Interface
layers.text: Where a person meets the system, and where it is clear what it will and will not do.

layers.title: Orchestration
layers.text: Which step follows which, which tools are available, and when to stop.

layers.title: Models
layers.text: The models that perform a task. They are a part, not the whole system.

layers.title: Data and boundaries
layers.text: Which information may be used, what stays out of reach, and how that is enforced.

layers.title: Human control
layers.text: Where a person decides, corrects, or holds an outcome back.

sections.title: What we mean
paragraphs: An intelligent system helps with work that is otherwise manual, slow or scattered: ordering text, proposing a next step, flagging an exception, walking someone through a procedure.
We start with that work. The model comes after, and only if it can carry the task. A demonstration is not a system.

sections.title: Approach
paragraphs: We describe the purpose, the users, and the cases in which the system should stay quiet. Only then the architecture: data, integrations, evaluation, and the place of the person.
Going live is a decision, not a switch. We agree how the system will be watched once it is in real use.

sections.title: Agents
paragraphs: An agent is software given a goal, allowed to use tools, and required to act inside limits. Those tools are ordinary systems: a file, an inbox, a database, an API.
Without an explicit stop, a record of what happened, and an owner in the organisation, an agent is not a tool. It is a risk. We build those three in.

sections.title: Inside a business
paragraphs: Most of the value is not a chat on its own. It is a task that already exists: customer information, internal knowledge, operational follow-up, a product feature that becomes more capable.
We do not state savings or accuracy we cannot support in the specific context. What the system must not decide belongs in the design.

software.metaDescription: Engineering, platforms and digital products. Northern Studio builds software an organisation can carry, with ownership agreed in writing.
software.title: Software a business can carry.
software.lede: We build platforms and digital products: from the first usable version to a system other people can understand, secure and continue.
software.figureIntro: Four moments. None of them is a phase we skip in order to look faster.

phases.title: Frame
phases.text: Purpose, users, limits, and what will deliberately not be built.

phases.title: Shape
phases.text: Structure, interface and the shape of the data, before the work spreads out.

phases.title: Build
phases.text: Implementation, tests, accessibility and security as part of the work.

phases.title: Keep
phases.text: Handover, documentation, and an agreement on who carries the software next.

sections.title: Engineering
paragraphs: We write software that stays readable: clear boundaries between parts, types where they catch mistakes early, and tests on the behaviour that must not break.
Security and accessibility are not a review at the end. A system only its author understands is not finished.

sections.title: Platforms and products
paragraphs: A platform is the software a business sets its own operation on: accounts, permissions, data, integrations, an interface that follows the work.
A digital product is that same seriousness, with a user outside the project team. We design the first version small enough to be used, and solid enough to grow.

sections.title: Ownership
paragraphs: For our own products, the software stays with Northern Studio. That is the core of the company.
On client work, intellectual property is agreed in writing. This website is not a contract, and it does not assign ownership by implication.

automation.metaDescription: Intelligent workflows, integrations and operational automation that stay explainable, and that a person can stop.
automation.title: Automation that can still be explained.
automation.lede: We connect systems and take repetitive steps out of people's hands. The path stays something a person can follow, and stop.
automation.figureIntro: Four points. The last is not an appendix: without a trail, automation cannot be accounted for.

steps.title: Signal
steps.text: An event, or a piece of data arriving. Not everything that arrives is an instruction.

steps.title: Rule
steps.text: What may happen, what a person must see, and what must never run on its own.

steps.title: System
steps.text: The integration or the task: another system, a message, an update in a record.

steps.title: Record
steps.text: A trail of what happened, so someone can look it up afterwards.

sections.title: Workflows
paragraphs: A lot of operational work is a series of handoffs: a form, a check, an update in a second system, a note to the person who continues.
We automate that handoff where the rule is clear. Where it is not, the step stays with a person. That is a design choice, not a leftover.

sections.title: Integrations
paragraphs: Systems rarely talk to each other on their own. We build the connection explicitly: which fields, which errors, what happens when the other side does not answer.
An integration that fails quietly is not automation. Errors stay visible to the person who has to repair them.

sections.title: Control
paragraphs: Every automation has an owner and a way to be switched off. Permissions stay narrow: the system receives only the access the task needs.
We do not promise that manual work disappears. We promise that the work which remains is clearer, and that the automatic part can be explained.

research.metaDescription: The questions Northern Studio keeps open: reliable intelligent systems, products that stay simple, and automation a person can still control.
research.title: Questions we are keeping open.
research.lede: This is not a lab, not a list of publications, and not a partnership. It is the short list of questions the next piece of work is held to.

inquiries.title: Reliability in use
inquiries.text: How does an intelligent system stay reliable once it is no longer a demonstration, but part of a real operation?

inquiries.title: Simplicity that can grow
inquiries.text: How does a product stay simple as its capabilities increase, instead of becoming a screen full of exceptions?

inquiries.title: Automation someone can control
inquiries.text: How does automation remain something the responsible person can still interrupt, without losing the trail?

inquiries.title: Software that lasts
inquiries.text: What infrastructure, documentation and ownership does software need in order to outlast the first delivery?

research.closeTitle: Nothing here is presented as a result.
research.closeText: When there is something we can make public, it will appear in this place. Until then we describe the direction, not the outcome.

about.metaDescription: Mission, vision and principles of Northern Studio, a technology and product company working from Belgium.
about.title: A studio for work we can carry.
about.lede: Northern Studio builds intelligent software, AI-powered systems and technology designed to move businesses forward. The long line is products whose ownership we can hold.
about.mission: To make software and systems that genuinely help a business forward, and that are solid enough to be owned — by us, or by a client when that is agreed in writing.
about.vision: An international technology and product company. Services fund the early work. Software we own sets the direction after that. We grow by what we can maintain, not by what we can announce.

principles.title: Ownership
principles.text: We treat code, design and data as something with an owner. For our own products, that is us. For client work, it is written down.

principles.title: Clarity
principles.text: We describe limits with the same care as capabilities. A system that seems able to do everything has been poorly explained.

principles.title: Care
principles.text: Security, accessibility, privacy and maintenance are part of the build. They are not offered as an option afterwards.

principles.title: Ambition, in measure
principles.text: The work may reach far. The step we take has to be one an organisation can carry, understand and switch off.

about.scope: We work from Belgium and build for organisations that look beyond a single local market. Figures, a team and a history will be published only once they are formally settled.

privacy.lede: This website collects little. What we ask for is used to reply in writing, or to send product news you requested yourself.

sections.title: Controller
paragraphs: The controller is Northern Studio. The formal identification has not yet been published on this site.

sections.title: Which data
paragraphs: Through the contact form: name, email, the message, and — if you provide them — organisation and subject.
Through the interest form: email, the place you chose, and — if you provide them — name and a note.
The server may hold your IP address briefly in memory to limit misuse of the forms. It is not stored as a cookie and not attached to a profile. There is no analytics or advertising tracker.

sections.title: Why
paragraphs: We process contact messages in order to reply. That is the legitimate interest of an ordinary business reply, or a step you take by sending the form.
We process an interest message only so we can send the product news you asked for. You can stop that in writing.

sections.title: How long
paragraphs: We keep a message until the question has been handled, and no longer than that correspondence, or the news you asked for, requires.

sections.title: Processors
paragraphs: This site is built to be hosted by the provider of the production environment. [TODO: confirm the hosting provider, for example Vercel, and put a processing agreement in place.]

We do not sell data, and we do not pass it on for anyone else's advertising.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can ask for access, correction or deletion, and you can object to processing that relies on legitimate interest. Do that in writing, through the contact form, until a confirmed email address exists.
You can also lodge a complaint with the Belgian supervisory authority.

sections.title: The site
paragraphs: The site introduces Northern Studio and offers a way to make contact in writing. Nothing on these pages is a proposal, professional advice, or a promise of a result.
Product places are not an offer. A status of “in development” or “coming soon” does not announce a delivery date.

sections.title: Use
paragraphs: You may read the site and use the forms for a genuine question. Automated abuse, sending someone else's data without a basis, or trying to disrupt the site, is not part of that.
We may temporarily block a form if too many messages arrive from the same address.

sections.title: Intellectual property

You may quote with attribution. You may not reproduce the site as if it were someone else's.

sections.title: Availability and liability
paragraphs: We try to keep the site available and accurate. We do not guarantee that it will be uninterrupted or free of errors.
To the extent the law allows, this informational site is not a basis for loss that follows from merely using it. [TODO: have this wording reviewed by counsel.]

cookiesPage.metaDescription: Northern Studio sets no cookies on this website and does not use a cookie banner.
cookiesPage.title: Cookies
cookiesPage.lede: This website does not set cookies of its own. There is no cookie banner.

sections.title: What is not here
paragraphs: No analytics cookies, no advertising, no social plug-ins, and no cookie that remembers your language. The language is in the address: Dutch with no prefix, English under /en.
The language control in the navigation is an ordinary link to the other version of the same page.

sections.title: What a provider may do
paragraphs: The hosting provider may keep technical logs, including IP addresses, to secure the site and to see abuse. Those are not cookies this site places in your browser.
[TODO: confirm the provider and how long logs are kept.]

sections.title: If that changes
paragraphs: A strictly necessary cookie will be introduced only after this page has been updated. Tracking will not be added without it being visible here.

accessibility.metaDescription: Northern Studio accessibility statement. This site is built toward WCAG 2.2 Level AA.
accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.lede: Northern Studio wants this website to be usable with a keyboard, a screen reader and without a mouse, and to stay readable when motion is reduced.

sections.title: Aim
paragraphs: We aim for the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, Level AA. That is a target for this site, not a certificate from a third party.

sections.title: What is in place
paragraphs: Semantic headings and landmarks, a skip link, visible focus, a label on every form field, errors in text, and a language switch that actually changes the page.
Motion is limited. Anyone who chooses reduced motion in their system gets no page movement and no line drawing in.
Colour is not the only carrier of a status. “In development” and “coming soon” are written in words.

sections.title: Known limits
paragraphs: We are not aware of a barrier we have deliberately left in place. A generated image for social previews has a text alternative; the page itself carries the same title as text.
If you meet an obstacle, write to us. We treat that as an ordinary, serious request.
